en.title: App Creator
en.summary: Write and build wapps inside XPRS
en.body: A full workshop for XPRS wapps. Write C code against the HAL API. Compile it to WebAssembly with the compiler that ships inside this wapp. Design screens in the visual editor and manage translations. Install the result straight to the launcher. No outside tools are needed.

pt.title: Criador de Apps
pt.summary: Escreva, compile e instale wapps dentro do XPRS
pt.body: Ambiente de desenvolvimento completo para wapps XPRS. Escreva codigo C contra a API HAL, compile para WebAssembly com o compilador wasm-clang incluido, desenhe ecras UI com o editor visual, gira traducoes e instale diretamente no launcher.

de.title: App Creator
de.summary: Wapps direkt in XPRS schreiben, kompilieren und installieren
de.body: Vollstaendige Entwicklungsumgebung fuer XPRS-Wapps. C-Code gegen die HAL-API schreiben, mit dem mitgelieferten wasm-clang-Compiler zu WebAssembly kompilieren, UI-Screens mit dem visuellen Editor gestalten, Uebersetzungen verwalten und direkt im Launcher installieren.

changelog:
## 0.1.0
- Initial release with C compiler, UI editor, translations tab
- NOSTR signing integration
- Project management with fork/edit/delete
